items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Doc said to me, said, Happy, come on talk with Charlie.

ctx.x: But Charlie, I mean, you know, I guess he's (unintelligible). I don't know.

Well, the main thing, Stanley, after he made that recording in '72, one of his eyes started to going bad, see? Well, last -- a year ago we (unintelligible) Doc Varner, and he called Doc because he did some recording for Doc, and Doc said to me, said, Happy, come on talk with Charlie. We all belong to the same club, the Friendly Fifty. I said, yeah, because Doc kept talking about he wanted to get him up there so he could do some recording.

So I said, oh, I said, let me talk to him. So I said, hey, what do you say, Buddy? Hey, Hap. I said, I'm coming by so we can -- want to bring you up there and got a little jam session. He wouldn't come. He won't come on the recording date either.
